gloss: very interesting; fascinating; of great interest

definitions.gloss: very interesting; fascinating; of great interest
definitions.explanation: Describes something that arouses deep interest or curiosity. More formal and emphatic than omoshiroi when expressing intellectual interest.

examples.japanese: {興味深|きょうみぶか}い⟦{結果|けっか}→結果：02486_kekka⟧だ。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{研究|けんきゅう}→研究：01396_kenkyuu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{非常|ひじょう}→非常：01598_hijou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{興味深|きょうみぶか}い。

⟦{歴史的|れきしてき}→歴史的：05671_rekishiteki⟧な⟦{背景|はいけい}→背景：28348_haikei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{知|し}る→知る：00458_shiru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{建物|たてもの}→建物：01458_tatemono⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧さらに{興味深|きょうみぶか}く⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: When you learn the historical background, this building becomes even more fascinating.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{興味|きょうみ}→興味：01316_kyoumi⟧ (interest) + ⟦{深|ふか}い→深い：01211_fukai⟧ (deep). Used to express genuine intellectual curiosity or fascination with a topic. More formal and objective than ⟦{面白|おもしろ}い→面白い：00589_omoshiroi⟧, which can also mean 'fun' or 'amusing.'

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {興味深|きょうみぶか}い⟦{結果|けっか}→結果：02486_kekka⟧: fascinating result
- {興味深|きょうみぶか}い⟦{発見|はっけん}→発見：00085_hakken⟧: interesting discovery
- {興味深|きょうみぶか}い⟦{事実|じじつ}→事実：03271_jijitsu⟧: interesting fact
- {興味深|きょうみぶか}い⟦{話|はなし}→話：01496_hanashi⟧: interesting story
- {興味深|きょうみぶか}く⟦{読|よ}む→読む：00426_yomu⟧: to read with great interest

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{面白|おもしろ}い→面白い：00589_omoshiroi⟧: interesting, fun — broader in meaning; can mean entertaining or amusing, not just intellectually interesting
- ⟦{関心|かんしん}→関心：00182_kanshin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧: to be interested in — expresses personal interest rather than describing the object as interesting

USAGE:
Often used in academic, journalistic, and formal contexts. The adverbial form {興味深|きょうみぶか}く is also common, as in {興味深|きょうみぶか}く⟦{拝見|はいけん}しました→拝見する：01823_haikensuru⟧ (I read/viewed it with great interest).
